fixtures._judgement: Cells only. upstreams.toml [auge] already records that Vision returns text observations and hands a table back column-major, so ROW RECONSTRUCTION is a known loss and no threshold here pretends to score it. What this page asks is narrower and still decides adoption: does every cell survive as characters.

The recorded failure, reconstructed. upstreams.toml [auge], 2026-08-31: Apple Vision read `=` as `-` on exactly this shape and expressed no fraction at all. The two strings under must_not_survive are that engine's literal wrong output, so this fixture fails on the signature that decided the ladder rather than on an aggregate that could hide it.
